specialRules: Trading away a future 1st-round pick locks in your commitment to the league through that pick's season: as soon as the trade is made, you must pay your buy-in for every season from the current year through the year that pick belongs to (for any of those years you haven't already paid). This stops a manager from selling off their future picks and then bailing on the league before those seasons happen. If the buy-in isn't submitted within 7 days of the trade, the trade is reversed.
